sentences.en: The professor thought it rude to say such a thing.
sentences.zh: 教授认为这样说很失礼。

sentences.en: Dr. Hellebrandt is an associate professor in that excellent university.
sentences.zh: 赫勒布兰特博士是那所优秀大学的一名副教授。

sentences.en: Professor Brown is very pleased about getting his book published.
sentences.zh: 布朗教授很高兴他的书被出版了。

senses.zh: 教授,（大学的）讲师，教员,自称者，宣称者
